rule: SHADOW records only: a NAMED cell of a family off the 2026-11-18 grandfather roster without a complete six-field EconomicPrior passes gate 1 as PRIOR_INCOMPLETE with its missing fields named. research/economic_prior_backfill.py writes LIVE (PRIOR_INCOMPLETE fails gate 1) when the forward exp_r of the clocks LIVE would refuse (family off the roster, no complete prior) is robustly negative, mean + 2 SE < 0 over >= 10 such clocks with >= 10 forward observations each (newest 200), SHADOW when mean - 1 SE > 0, and leaves the mode alone in between and below the window. Complete-minus-incomplete is reported as a diagnostic only. pinned=true freezes the mode; OFF stops the requirement.
